reason: projectPaths always returns exactly two read roots (the write root and its fallback), so reads.slice(1) holds one directory and some and every give the same answer for every layout, including a symlinked or dangling fallback, since both test that one directory with the same existsSync calls.

Epochs live only in this process's memory and are compared for equality only; counting down from 0 is as strictly monotonic as counting up, so every build that started before a dispose sees a different epoch and every later build the same one, whatever the order of dispose, build, maintenance or disposeAll calls.
